whatsNew.summary: Switch the meeting assistant model right under the Ask box. Drop or paste a screenshot to attach it to the meeting. Live COS Ask keeps every question and answer. Requires server 6.70.0. Private test candidate.

sections.title: Ask keeps its history
items: Questions, answers and sources stay with the meeting after you switch meetings, save it or restart COS Control.
Unsent questions are saved too. Stop or retry an answer yourself, and nothing reruns on its own.
Saved meetings show their Ask history. Sources open the transcript line, earlier meeting, memory, file or web page they came from.

sections.title: Files, models and copy
items: Add files while a meeting records. Their text is shared with Ask, and files it cannot safely read are labeled instead.
Pick the Meeting assistant model under the Ask box or in Settings. Haiku stays the default, and other chats keep their own models.
Copy full context adds every answer, its sources and file text to the transcript. Copy transcript on a saved meeting copies only the transcript.
Drag the divider to resize the Ask panel. The preset buttons now line up on the left.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Dropping or pasting a screenshot on the Ask box attaches it to the meeting. It no longer sends the file path as your question.
Ask keeps saving while the Mac is locked during a meeting. It no longer shows a false Check free disk space error.
A live transcript that keeps failing after a recording ends stops retrying after five minutes.
An older server shows an update message for Ask. The live transcript keeps working.
Ordinary public questions like who is or look up can search the web, with server 6.70.0. Your meeting details never go into a search.
